newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia TRI says D.Telekom soon on board.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia TRI says D.Telekom soon on board.

text.p: Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI) President Tajudin Ramli said on Monday that Deutsche Telekom AG, which bought a 21 percent stake in the Malaysian firm earlier this month, has submitted two names for TRI's board.
"The two will be on the board in the immediate future," Tajudin told reporters after launching a new information service on TRI's Celcom mobile phone network.
The nominees from the German company have to be approved by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, he added.

Deutsche Telekom will bring its expertise in fixed line networks to the table, Tajudin said. "Deutsche Telekom's expertise is rolling out a fixed line network," he said. TRI has licenses to operate a fixed line telephone network, an international gateway, and multimedia applications in addition to its mobile phone service.

TRI said on October 10 that Deutsche Telekom had purchased 68.07 million new shares at 9.25 ringgit each for an initial stake of 10 percent. Deutsche Telekom said it bought another 11 percent of TRI's expanded share capital in the open market.
